raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that John Bowes, 9th Earl of Strathmore and Kinghorne, was "from England" based on his marriage record in Westminster, London. However, this reasoning conflates the location of a single event (his marriage) with his country of origin. John Bowes held a Scottish noble title and was part of the Scottish aristocracy, which strongly indicates his origin is Scotland, not England. The Planner failed to prioritize the noble lineage and title, which are more reliable indicators of origin in this context.
